_doc: Per-task harness overrides — bench-hygiene repairs for env-broken tasks (2026-07-07).
Applied by run-pilot.mjs at loadTasks (SR mode): mutates the in-memory spec so the
agent-phase run_tests (bareapi + codex shim) AND grading (tasks.json fed to eval.py)
all see the same repaired task. Fields per instance_id:
testTimeoutSec — replaces the 300s default INSIDE the run_tests container (agent phase only;
grading has no per-test timeout, only the 90-min GRADE_BATCH ceiling).
testCmd        — replaces install_config.test_cmd (agent phase AND grading).
image          — replaces image_name with a locally-built derived repair image
(swerebenchv2-fixed/*; never pulled — must exist locally, see
network        — 'bridge' exempts this task's containers from the egress lockdown
(default under lockdown is --network none; loopback always works).
dockerRunArgs  — extra docker-run args for this task's run_tests/grading containers

jump-dev__jump.jl-2714._why: JuMP full suite measured 2m58 clean / 2m53 with source edit applied (idle box, --network none) — right AT the 300s cliff, so under real run load (3-4 concurrent tasks + grading) every historical run_tests timed out (68-call thrash). 600s = ~3.4x idle-measured, load-aware headroom.

juliadebug__cthulhu.jl-547._why: THREE defects: (1) Pkg.test() defaults to --check-bounds=yes which disables the @inbounds DCE the F2P test asserts (repo CI runs --check-bounds=auto); (2) the Manifest pins LoweredCodeUtils.jl as a git dep NOT baked into the image depot, so Pkg.test clones from github at test time — derived image pre-seeds the depot; (3) Julia prints per-testset summary rows ONLY on failure — a fully-PASSING suite shows a single aggregate 'runtests.jl' row, so the name-based parser can never credit the F2P/P2P names (structurally ungradeable-on-success). The `&& printf` tail emits a synthetic summary table for the 26 expected testset names IFF the suite exits 0 (aggregate pass logically implies every nested testset passed). Grading becomes all-or-nothing for this task (partial passes still grade NO) — documented degradation, strictly better than permanently-NO.
